# Tier `blackwell-8`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 16384 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot and is the agent's default |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 16384 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `cpu_moe` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Media

**This tier ships no media configuration.** It serves text only until an operator binds
the media routes by hand, so `generate_image`, `generate_video`, `generate_audio` and
`run_graph` will report `NOT CONFIGURED` — or `BOUND-BUT-MISSING` where a shipped default
script path does not exist on the machine. Run `local-offload doctor` to see which.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Configs #8/#9 (5060 8GB Blackwell; +64GB adds 26B cpu-moe). E4B resident full-GPU. REQUIRES the Blackwell CUDA-12.8 sm_120 build (Task H4). 26B cpu-moe only when ram_tier mid/high; else dropped. J4: config_seed_ram_mid_high auto-binds the O1 bf16 IMAGE seat on mid/high-RAM boxes (verified on the ampere-8 reference box; image only — no video/music on 8GB by decision 2026-07-23). PROJECTED.

## Capability report

No report is checked in for this tier yet. If you run this tier, yours is welcome —
